methods.name: Peer-Median

data.narrative:
CreateMe operates in Robotics & Manufacturing, a sector with limited comparable public benchmarks (1 traded company) and a fragmented private peer landscape of 8 identified competitors including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The company's specific stage and prior funding remain undisclosed, constraining stage-specific valuation anchoring.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. The sector contains 10 same-sector peers total, but insufficient depth within narrow filters: zero same-stage matches, zero adjacent-stage matches, and zero similar-valuation-tier matches were identified. The analysis would require a minimum of 3 datapoints within comparable cohorts to establish a defensible peer median; this threshold was not met. Applying an all-sector median across such heterogeneous stages and valuations would introduce material distortion and was rejected on that basis.

Without sufficient stage-aligned or tier-aligned private comparables, and with only one public market reference point, conventional triangulation methods do not yield a quantitatively grounded valuation range. A credible valuation narrative for CreateMe would require either: (1) disclosure of current stage and recent fundraising terms to enable stage-filtered peer analysis, or (2) a shift to bottom-up, revenue-forward methodologies tied to disclosed operational metrics. Key uncertainties remain the company's revenue scale, margin profile, and capital efficiency relative to the fragmented peer set.
